question: The flat-topped table land standing above the surrounding area is called ______.
solution:
The correct answer is** "__Plateau__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Plateau **is an area having raised land that is flat on the top.
 
• These are formed when Magma located deep inside the earth pushes the surface but fails to break through the crust.
 
• There are two types of plateaus - **Dissected plateau and Volcanic plateau.**
